user.title: Set up UK Journey Guardian
user.description: Connect a travel calendar, routing providers, and destination zones. Credentials are stored by Home Assistant and are never exposed as entity state.

data.station_access_mode: Default way to reach the station

data_description.calendar_entity: Calendar containing timed rail journey events.
data_description.person_entity: Person whose location will be used for travel decisions.
data_description.home_zone: Zone used to identify home departures.
data_description.destination_zones: Optional zones representing one or more regular destinations.
data_description.preparation_buffer_minutes: Minutes allowed to get ready before leaving for the station.
data_description.station_buffer_minutes: Minutes to arrive at the station before the scheduled train departure.
data_description.station_access_mode: Auto compares suitable modes; a fixed mode can be selected instead.
data_description.transportapi_app_id: Optional until TransportAPI rail monitoring is enabled.
data_description.transportapi_app_key: Optional until TransportAPI rail monitoring is enabled. Stored privately in the Home Assistant config entry.
data_description.google_routes_api_key: Optional until Google routing is enabled. Use a dedicated restricted server-side Routes API key.
data_description.daily_api_limit: Maximum TransportAPI calls permitted each local day.
data_description.urgent_api_reserve: Routine checks stop before consuming this final reserve.

error.reserve_must_be_lower: The urgent reserve must be lower than the daily limit.

abort.already_configured: UK Journey Guardian is already configured.

review_now.name: Review journey now
review_now.description: Immediately refresh the calendar and UK Journey Guardian decision path.
